name: yair
description: YAIR (Yet Another Inbox Revamp) browser extension for Reddit private messages

scripts.lint:firefox: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files node_modules dist package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.js "scss/**" "images/promotional/**" "*.md" ".github/**" "test/**"
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files node_modules dist package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.js "scss/**" "images/promotional/**" "*.md" ".github/**" "test/**"
